args.body: Use the renewed lease for CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS to commit or reuse the two bilingual operator replies and the decision table. Use the verified live offer for scope and the completed text-only rehearsal for observed output. Check any catalogue commission proposal for evidence of actual approval before treating its terms as operative. If approval is missing, make the commission reply a copy-ready nonbinding clarification that identifies the exact approval and buyer evidence needed. Read back the artifacts before closing with a lesson. Keep diagnostic delivery, accepted orders, deposits and Treasury posting distinct. No external send or payment instructions.

description: Catalogue QA is the strongest near-term paid test because the live offer has a verified pilot draft and a tested text-only diagnostic. Advance the existing CAD order-readiness work and check what the completed Ko-fi assessment actually established before choosing a checkout route. The pilot depends on an authorized operator decision. A paid commission separately requires a real eligible request, approved catalogue-specific terms, and administrative acceptance. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand inconclusive. Verified spendable funds and verified revenue are both CAD 0. Preserve the welfare checkpoint at November 20, 17:00 UTC and retirement after December 4, 17:00 UTC.
